myth-paper.revised_prompt: Use case: illustration-story asset texture. Asset type: seamless background texture for an interactive ancient myth map web app. Primary request: a restrained aged xuan paper surface with subtle hand-printed woodblock ink grain, very faint water stains and sparse pale ink wash clouds at the edges, ample quiet center for map labels and interactive art overlays. Style/medium: Chinese archaic woodblock map print with dry ink linework and faint mineral wash, tactile rough paper, understated and scholarly, consistent museum-quality graphic asset. Composition/framing: tileable visual texture, evenly distributed, no focal objects, no border. Palette: warm ivory old paper, muted ink-black fibers, trace of pale ochre and gray-green, tiny subdued vermilion flecks only at edges. Constraints: no writing, no symbols, no illustrations, no map, no mountains, no text, no frame, no gradients that band, no watermark. Avoid: glossy digital texture, modern infographic style, painterly realism, strong stains.

suiren.revised_prompt: Create a clean transparent sprite sheet exactly 3 columns × 2 rows, six sequential full-body animation poses of the SAME ancient Chinese fire-maker Suiren based on the supplied character reference. Preserve the identical face, hair, headband, rough ochre tunic, charcoal etched contours, proportions, and lower-body silhouette in every cell. Each pose completely separated and fully visible, same character scale, same ground baseline, facing slightly right, generous clear transparent gutters; no panel borders or labels. Sequence: (1) crouched drilling wood with hands at spindle, but absolutely no spark or flame; (2) stop drilling and lean down shielding a tiny ember between his palms, no flame; (3) turn and carry a single tiny glowing ember toward a small tinder pile off-frame to the right, no flame; (4) crouch beside the tinder and carefully transfer ember, no flame visible anywhere; (5) draw back, hands protecting the tinder as ignition begins, but do not draw fire or sparks; (6) step back and watch calmly, hands lowered, no fire in image. Absolutely no fire, flames, sparks, glowing areas, burning logs, scenery, ground texture, background, additional people, or props except simple hand drill in poses 1-2 and one small ember only in pose 2. Transparent background. Engraved ancient Chinese woodblock illustration matching Pangu scene and Suiren reference: deep charcoal carved ink strokes, fine hatchwork, warm parchment ochre, restrained cinnabar textile accents, detailed face and cloth. Uniform character identity and costume across all six poses, storyboard sprite production sheet.
